title: Monstrous Manor Trophy
html:
"Happy Halloween!"

In-game description

The Monstrous Manor Trophy is an event-exclusive collectible trophy introduced during the Halloween 2025 update. It is an extremely rare drop obtained from defeating enemies that appear during the Blood Moon event.

Details

The Monstrous Manor Trophy serves purely as a decorative collectible, rewarding players who successfully defeat enemies during the Blood Moon. As one of the rarest obtainable trophies in the game, it symbolizes victory over the corrupted forces that emerged throughout the Halloween 2025 event. The trophy cannot be repurchased or found in stores, making it a highly sought-after item among players who participated in the event.

Appearance

The Monstrous Manor Trophy features an intricately designed golden base with twisting ornamental stems that rise to support a miniature model of the Monstrous Manor, the central structure of the Halloween 2025 event. The manor sits prominently atop the pedestal, with the word “Halloween” floating above it in crimson letters, while “2025” is embossed on the front of the base in matching red. Its bright, metallic sheen and detailed craftsmanship make it stand out as both a memento of the event and a mark of rare achievement.

Trivia

  • The Monstrous Manor Trophy is the only trophy to directly feature a structure from its respective event.
  • It was first introduced alongside the return of the Blood Moon mechanic in the Halloween 2025 update.
  • Because of its extremely low drop rate, few players managed to obtain the Monstrous Manor Trophy during the event, making it one of the rarest decorative trophies in Oaklands.
